methodology.raisim_library: Existing build-benchmark/lib/libraisim.so.2.13.0, built November 6; identical library used for both MuJoCo versions and the RaiSim measurements.
limitations: A full rebuild is blocked by pre-existing changes to include_internal/helpers.hpp that do not compile with src/World.cpp. Existing user changes were preserved.

MuJoCo 4.0 benchmark translation units were rebuilt with installed RaiSim headers matching the existing RaiSim library (layout stamp 0xbcf1ae91b55ef9ad). The temporary launcher omits the unrelated segmentation_camera entry, whose current implementation requires a newer RaiSim library.
Cube-stack timings are excluded for both MuJoCo versions because every repeat reports QACC instability (3.13 at 0.0200 s; 4.0 at 0.0210 s).
These measurements use different hardware from the published October 14 documentation results; the historical results have been preserved.
Docker Clang 20 Ubuntu 20.04 and ARM GCC 10 toolchains were unavailable (no Docker socket).
validation: MuJoCo header/runtime version and collision-profiler regression test passed.
MuJoCo benchmark warning-handler regression test passed.
